reuse.why: Reuses the shared assertNotLinkedElsewhere guard for all six providers, but copies the local field reset from unlinkAccount instead of extracting it into a helper both can call.

duplication.why: The eight-field updateAccount reset that unlinkAccount performs is pasted verbatim into assertNotLinkedElsewhere.

placement.why: A mutating unlink is buried inside a function named and used as an assertion, and runs before the link itself is created, mixing validation and side effects.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing, the takeover logic and a release note are changed.

maintainability.why: The single choke point for all providers is good, but the misleading assert name with side effects and the duplicated reset (which will drift if unlink gains a field) make it harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere re-does unlinkAccount's local reset with its own db.updateAccount instead of a shared local-unlink helper extracted from unlinkAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied reset block in assertNotLinkedElsewhere is a literal copy of unlinkAccount's updateAccount call, not disguised.
